intent.problem: Engineering teams need prioritized architecture improvements that an implementation agent can execute safely without allowing the advisory workflow itself to change code.
intent.target_users: Staff engineers, architects, technical leads, maintainers, and engineering managers.

safety.reason: The product is advisory only and the analysis environment is air-gapped.

product.benefit: Turns a bounded source snapshot into triangulated architecture findings, explicit counter-evidence, migration options, and implementation prompts that a separate coding agent can use safely.
product.customizable_for: Legacy-system modernization, monolith modularization, dependency-risk review, interface stabilization, change-risk analysis, and engineering planning.
product.how_it_works: Validates a local source folder; builds authoritative static evidence with a bundled offline skill; runs eight required grounded passes through the runtime-selected default local model; adversarially audits every finding and prompt; then deterministically publishes only an approved read-only advice bundle.
product.input: One local source folder and optional architecture focus.
product.output: Architecture assessment, normalized fact database, numbered deep-dive reports, adversarial review, migration options, and standalone copy-ready prompts for another AI coding agent.
product.problem: Teams need credible architectural improvement plans without giving an analysis workflow permission to execute, alter, or upload their code.
runtime_features: eight required fail-closed LLM analysis passes
product.simulation_type: Offline deep static evidence collection plus eight serial local-model passes for reconstruction, cross-cutting analysis, finding synthesis, adversarial review, prompt authoring, report synthesis, and final audit.
product.target_users: Staff engineers, architects, technical leads, maintainers, and engineering managers.
